lesson.meaning: A group of people who work together towards a common goal or purpose.
examples: Our marketing team launched a very successful campaign last quarter.
It's important for everyone to work as a team to meet the project deadline.
She's a great team player, always supporting her colleagues.
The engineering team is currently developing new features for the software.
During our meeting, we discussed how to improve communication within the team.
lesson.memory_tip: Remember: T.E.A.M. often stands for 'Together Everyone Achieves More'! It helps you recall the core idea of working together.
